other_failure_modes.name: Feature Leakage across CV folds
other_failure_modes.description: Computing aggregate features (like group means or frequencies) on the entire training dataset before cross-validation leaks information from validation folds into training folds, which can cause overfitting and overly optimistic CV scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Categorical features treated as numerical in tree models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent label-encodes categorical features into integers but does not specify them as categorical when passing to tree models (like CatBoost, LightGBM, or XGBoost), causing the models to treat them as continuous ordinal variables, which can degrade performance.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with extensive feature engineering, target encoding, a PyTorch TabularResNet, and optimized ensembling. However, it suffers from data leakage by fitting a LabelEncoder on the combined train and test sets, and by computing frequency and mean aggregations on the entire training set before cross-validation splitting. Additionally, categorical variables are not properly declared to tree models.
